command: effect event_target:eep_colossus_probe_target = { fire_on_action = { on_action = on_destroy_planet_with_PLANET_KILLER_CRACKER scopes = { from = event_target:eep_mothership0 } } }
command_precondition: Actual native reload of pk2base plus revalidation of target17 natural last-colony status and the current Mother fleet target. This read-only source inspection is not an executed reload.
expected_source_semantics: Full native completed-callback event dispatch, not a real weapon order, charge or fire.
planet_destruction.100 kills owned pops, destroys orbital defence, removes buildings; ordinary habitable world changes to pc_shattered with native random mineral deposits.
Native menace/diplomacy/threat/war-exhaustion/flags and any country/war removal are preserved as separate control-side observations.
Whether nomads.94 invalid FROM repeats and how war/country scopes propagate remain runtime questions.

log_offsets.baseline: Capture source path/run/UTC, B bytes and SHA256(prefix B) after actual base load; preserve earlier native-shot/startup records.
log_offsets.pre: Capture P and prefix hash immediately before dispatch; verify prefix B unchanged; retain [B,P) separately.
log_offsets.post: Capture Q and prefix hash after callback plus native post save; verify prefix P unchanged; retain exact raw [P,Q) plus SHA256 and offsets.
log_offsets.restore: Actual reload of untouched base then native save; keep [Q,R) separate and raw strict save differences.
log_offsets.rotation_rule: Any truncation/prefix mismatch invalidates append-only offsets; no zero-error conclusion.
log_offsets.scope: Stage observations of active logs; not a final frozen snapshot. Full final log freeze requires stopped process.

document_role: Historical pre-execution plan/source record; current observed execution is reported separately.
